classification_definitions.integration: Core assertion materially traverses genuine project file/store/protocol/process/runtime boundary; actual filesystem effect/readback can qualify the narrow boundary.
classification_definitions.unit: Local validation, crypto/clock predicate, fake records/counters or pre-I/O guard; incidental files/logs do not qualify.
classification_definitions.mixed: Independent local-only obligations alongside material real boundary effects.
classification_definitions.unresolved: Missing/ambiguous source/mapping or source-blocked obligation; distinct from runtime UNKNOWN.

fixture.reason: Actual temporary baked/staged/proof files with fixture-generated keys. Binaries are arbitrary text; lineage accepts; production gate metadata is fabricated. No replacement executable/systemd process is launched.

citations.text: func (anyLineage) CheckLineage(string, string, string) error { return nil }

staging.reason: Receipt verification precedes file access. Valid stage copies/hashes/chmods/syncs actual temporary release bytes, renames and verifies readback; failure cleans up. Seed reads baked bytes and selects its symlink.

layout.reason: Actual Lstat/Readlink/file opens, bounded read/hash, atomic symlink rename and synced atomic file replacement implement the asserted node-local release state.

citations.text: func (layout Layout) Current() (string, error) { return layout.readLink(currentLink) }
func (layout Layout) KnownGood() (string, error) { return layout.readLink(knownGoodLink) }
func (layout Layout) flipCurrent(digest string) error { return layout.flipLink(currentLink, digest) }

activation.reason: Pending/recovery read owned state files; activation verifies persisted bytes, writes activation then flips current; known-bad reads/writes actual durable records.

watch.reason: Watch reads actual pending/current/known-bad/target/proof files. Confirmation writes history/link then removes activation. Rollback marks bad, restores link, writes restart marker and removes activation. Process probe uses existing test PID; Prepare clears marker and verifies current files.

backstop.reason: Real pending/known-bad/target readback controls durable rollback after damage or deadline grace; undecodable record is left untouched.

pruning.reason: Actual release enumeration/removal protects known-good/current/baked/confirmed state. Assigned root asserts known-good survives returned removals.

restart.reason: Restart obligation is a real owned marker file; Prepare removes it. No systemd restart occurs.

confirmed.reason: Actual confirmation-index readback and synced atomic persistence occur before activation removal.

proof.reason: Proof file bytes enter signature/activation/unit/target/deadline validation. Fixture uses existing test PID. EmitProof/health of a replacement process is not exercised.

restore.reason: Known-good scenario invokes actual Restore: durable intent precedes bad/restart markers and symlink switch; it leaves known-good link unchanged.

dropin.reason: Exact logging text/wrapper delegates to real file installer.

dropin-io.reason: Actual unit Stat, drop-in ReadFile, directory creation and atomic write support absent-unit/first-install/idempotency checks. No systemd parsing or loading.

qualified-verifier.reason: Current signed update and independent production-qualification envelope checked in memory before staging I/O.

update-verifier.reason: Local scope/provenance/delegation/clock checks; fixture lineage accepts. No source-host/provider connection.

production-verifier.reason: Local expected scope/envelope/gate metadata checks do not execute fixture runtime-ha/workload-safety evidence.

backup-fixture.reason: Provider methods are map-backed create/list/get/delete/VolumeGone, fake ETag checks, injected onGet/time and fake fencer errors/counters. No SDK/transport/broker/store.

backup-plan.reason: Matching/sort/cadence/idempotency/prune decisions return local action records only.

backup-policy.reason: 24h backup cadence, seven-entry/full cadence and 30d orphan retention are fixed local constants.

backup-runner.reason: RunOnce reaches fake provider/fencer methods in these roots. ETag/ownership/partial listing/orphan proof are map/counter effects. Logging is incidental/unasserted.

authority-predicate.reason: Local snapshot identity/lease flags/clock predicate; no authority-store exchange.

decision-log.reason: Fallback structured logging is incidental; no journal recorder constructed by these fixtures or asserted logging effect.

decision-correlations.reason: Bounded process-local map, not durable backup evidence.

qualification_limits: All20 declarations remain exact canonical/baseline bytes; no source-visible contradiction identified. Source classification never establishes pass/fail.
Self-update uses actual temporary files/symlinks and arbitrary text binaries. No replacement executable/systemd process, root-owned deployment or concurrent Layout.Lock discipline is qualified.
Fixture signs its own keys/receipts/qualification, accepts lineage and fabricates gate metadata. Existing test PID is used for liveness; no new target executable proves health.
Stage authorization pre-I/O blocks remain independent unit obligations alongside actual staging/cleanup.
Backup provider/authority/ETags/termination/volumes are fake maps/counters/snapshots; no OCI/NATS/durable journal/actual provider deletion or live backup/restore proof.
